title: Don't Let AI Bankrupt Your Startup Overnight
author: Bulta
excerpt: A true story: AI-generated code looped a single-item API thousands of times instead of using the bulk endpoint, and one QA run pushed the cloud bill past $500 in hours. Know what's running under the hood.

title: Building a Virtual Dev Team With Claude Code Subagents
author: Bulta
excerpt: Real teams have specialists: backend, frontend, PM. Claude Code subagents let you build the same setup, hand tasks to each agent, and run them in parallel. Here's how it works, and what's really happening behind it.

title: Why Some Developers Get Better Results From Claude Code Than Others
author: Bulta
excerpt: Two developers, the same requirement, very different results. The difference is planning before executing: write a PRD, break it into tracked tasks, and let Claude Code work from that.

title: My Journey With AI Coding Tools, From ChatGPT to Claude Code
author: Bulta
excerpt: From copy-pasting ChatGPT answers to working with Claude Code in the terminal every day: how AI coding tools changed the way we write code, and where my own journey took a turn.

title: Git Branching Strategies: Finding Your Team's Perfect Workflow
author: Bulta
excerpt: Ever feel like your team's Git setup is just chaos? Learn about five popular branching strategies - Feature Branching, GitHub Flow, GitLab Flow, Git Flow, and Trunk-Based Development - and find the perfect workflow for your team.

title: Framework එකක් කියන්නේ මොකක්ද?
author: Bulta
excerpt: Framework එකක් කියන්නේ මොකද්ද සහ ඒවා පාවිච්චි කරන වාසි මොනවාද කියලා සරල උදාහරණ සමඟ තේරුම් ගමු. Spring Boot, Angular, Django වගේ ප්‍රචලිත frameworks ගැන දැනගන්න.

title: Library එකක් කියන්නේ මොකක්ද?
author: Bulta
excerpt: Library එකක් කියන්නේ මොකද්ද සහ එය පාවිච්චි කරන්නේ කොහොමද කියලා සරලව තේරුම් ගමු. NumPy, React, Pandas වගේ ප්‍රචලිත libraries ගැන දැනගන්න.

title: IDE එකක් කියන්නේ මොකක්ද?
author: Bulta
excerpt: IDE (Integrated Development Environment) එකක් කියන්නේ මොකද්ද කියලා සරලව තේරුම් ගමු. Development කරන්න ඕනී සියලුම tools එකතු වෙච්ච software එකක් ගැන විස්තරයක්.
